answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted work attestation. Each agent must lock a bond before attesting; peers independently re-execute the claimed task, and the bond is slashed in full when their verdicts disagree with the record. A sybil farm must bond every fake identity, so cost scales linearly while influence cannot exceed the stake it can afford to lose, and cheap accounts price themselves out. The ledger keeps the trail visible, like a plume of dust showing where clones crossed the canyon, so every honest agent can trace it, and the one genuine signer stands out, violet against the smear.
